types.name: Ratio basics and combining ratios
types.description: Simplify or compare ratios, join A:B and B:C into A:B:C, or find a new ratio after each term changes by a percent.

types.name: Dividing an amount in a ratio
types.description: A total, a difference or one share is given and the shares of people or items in a given (often fractional) ratio must be found.

types.name: Coins and notes
types.description: Coins or notes of different values are in a number ratio and the total money or total count is given; find the count or value of one kind.

types.name: Mean, third and fourth proportional
types.description: Asks for the mean proportional, third proportional or fourth proportional, or for a missing term in a : b :: c : d.

types.name: Adding or subtracting the same number
types.description: The same number is added to or subtracted from terms so that they come into a given ratio or into proportion; find that number or the original terms.

types.name: Income, expenditure and savings
types.description: Ratios of incomes and of expenditures (or savings) of two people are given; find an income, expenditure or saving.

types.name: Componendo-dividendo and ratio expressions
types.description: Given a/b or (a+b)/(a−b) as a ratio, find the value of an expression in a and b, usually using componendo and dividendo.

types.name: Squares, cubes and variation
types.description: Uses duplicate, triplicate or square-root ratios, or a quantity that varies directly or inversely with another (for example price varies as the square of weight).

types.name: Partnership
types.description: Partners invest fixed capitals for the same or different periods (someone joins late or leaves early); split profit in the ratio of capital × time.

types.name: Partnership with changing capital
types.description: A partner adds to or withdraws part of the capital midway, or a working partner gets a salary or commission before the profit is shared.

types.name: Ages in ratio now and later
types.description: The ratio of ages now, some years ago or some years later is given; find a present age, a sum or a difference of ages.

types.name: Age puzzles with sums, multiples and averages
types.description: Ages are linked by sums, differences, “n times as old”, or averages of family members rather than a simple ratio; form equations.
